dataset.name: MQTT-IoT-IDS2020
dataset.citation: H. Hindy, C. Tachtatzis, R. Atkinson, E. Bayne and X. Bellekens, "MQTT-IoT-IDS2020: MQTT Internet of Things Intrusion Detection Dataset", IEEE DataPort, 2020, doi: 10.21227/bhxy-ep04.

temporal_data_statement: No timestamp column was found in the flow CSVs ({'uniflow': [], 'biflow': []}). Row order is therefore NOT treated as time, no artificial timestamps are created, and no temporal claim is made anywhere in this project. The temporal extension (ST-EGAT-GRU) remains future work pending packet-level or PCAP data.
